## Key Angle

**Two men split the world in half. The line they drew is still visible today — in language, in borders, in inequality.**

The Treaty of Tordesillas (1494) is the FIRST time European powers drew a line on a map to divide territory they didn't control. It's the blueprint for everything that came after: Berlin Conference, Sykes-Picot, Mandate System.
